verdict.rationale: Discord documents a Gateway API that lets apps open secure WebSocket connections to receive real-time events about server/guild actions. It also documents HTTP delivery of event notifications to apps, and bot-token authentication for bots. missing for 10: explicit documentation that message-create events are delivered (the cited examples are channel and role events), detail on intents and connection lifecycle, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build a bot that receives messages and events in real time through an events API or gateway connection

citations.quote: The Gateway API lets apps open secure WebSocket connections with Discord to receive events about actions that take place in a server/guild, like when a channel is updated or a role is created.
